messages:
noah: Heads-up: Finance flagged a small but steady billing delta since last midnight. Many requests from dedicated SA keys are being charged against org quota instead of project quota. Not huge, but consistent.

sophia: saw that too, opened a quick query. The console's quota-attribution panel shows ~0.7% of tokens billed to `org:unknown` for dedicated pools.

raj: pulled trace samples. Pattern: service account tokens that were minted via the new cross-project mint API arrive at auth-router with claim `sub=service:acct-xyz` but missing `project_id` claim. Router falls back to org-level quota. snippet: 
```
WARN auth-router: token=sub=service:acct-xyz claims_missing=[project_id] action=attribute_to_org org=org:12345
```

dena: hmm, the mint API should have attached `x-project` header from the exchange. Did we change the exchange contract? I recall the new mint flow returns an ephemeral claim blob only.

noah: migration note said exchange will attach `x-project` for backwards compat, but maybe Dedicated pools are still hitting an older exchange sidecar.

raj: confirmed: Dedicated sidecar image is `exchange:v2.0.3` whereas hosted pools are `exchange:v2.1.0` which encodes project into the claim. v2.0.3 returns a blob and expects downstream to call `GET /claim` to resolve. auth-router doesn't do that.

sophia: so we have two options: 1) make auth-router call `GET /claim` when seeing service tokens without project_id, 2) update Dedicated sidecars ASAP, or 3) add a temporary header `x-quota-owner` at ingress generated by an upstream proxy that already knows project mapping.

dena: option 1 is invasive but lowest-deploy surface. It means auth-router will synchronously consult exchange for the missing project claim. risk: added latency and extra call per warmup token.

noah: product cares about accuracy over tiny latency blips for billing. but ops wants minimal extra RT.

raj: we can be smarter: only call `GET /claim` when token type=service and project_id missing, and cache results keyed by token-hash for 60s. That should limit extra load. Also emit metric `auth.missing_project_triggered_claim_resolve`.

ops-bot: alert-bot: quota-attribution-anomaly threshold crossed for org:12345 - 0.7% misattribution in last 1h (suppressed if maintenance flag set).

sophia: telemetry ask: need dashboard tiles for `misattributed_quota_rate`, `claim_resolve_latency`, `dedicated_sidecar_version` breakdown, and top offending sa ids. product wants retention 90d to reconcile billing.

dena: agree. Also add an audit log export for all resolved claim lookups so finance can replay mappings.

noah: timeline proposal: small patch to auth-router to do conditional GET /claim + cache + metric behind feature-flag `auth.resolve_missing_project` -> canary to Dedicated alpha pool, monitor for 6h, then flip globally.

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-router/pull/395 - conditional claim resolve, cache, metrics, header `x-quota-owner` set when resolved.

sophia: I'll add dashboard panels and an alert: page if `misattributed_quota_rate > 0.5%` for 10m. Also add a log-export for the audit events to GCS.

dena: ops concern: what if exchange is down? auth-router should fallback to org attribution (current behaviour) and increment `auth.claim_resolve_failures`. We should avoid blocking requests.

noah: agreed. Make call best-effort with a 150ms timeout and circuit-breaker for exchange failures. Add `x-auth-resolve` header to indicate resolution outcome in traces.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Feature-flag `auth.resolve_missing_project` enabled for group `dedicated-alpha` at 2025-11-04T02:12:05Z.

raj: after canary I can coordinate updating Dedicated sidecars to v2.1.0 so this becomes unnecessary long-term. But the router patch buys us immediate correctness.

noah: good. someone's got to update the console docs to explain `x-quota-owner` and the audit export. Sophia?

sophia: on it. I'll also add a migration note for customers with on-prem Dedicated so they know the sidecar update timeline.

dena: final ask: include a table in the dashboard that shows per-client misattribution delta pre/post enabling the feature-flag so finance can validate reversions.

noah: will monitor for 24h post-rollout and sync with finance tomorrow AM. thanks team.
